text: Day 1 of Broncos Training Camp kicked off Wednesday — and on Orange & Blue Today, Cecil and Mase break down everything they saw from the first practice of 2026. No fans yet, but the tempo was high, the changes were obvious, and the storylines were already popping. The offense looked different immediately. Davis Webb has stamped his identity all over this unit — more pre‑snap motion, more disguise, more stress on the defense before the ball is snapped. It’s a clear evolution from last year’s structure. Jaylen Waddle flashed superstar juice with multiple big plays, showing exactly why Denver made the blockbuster trade. But the player of the day — the guy who stole the show — was Marvin Mims. Sharper routes. Cleaner breaks. Trademark speed. Mims looked like a man on a mission to go from “almost forgotten” to the Broncos’ No. 3 WR behind Waddle and Courtland Sutton. Cecil and Mase break down how real this breakout looks — and whether he can sustain it all camp long. And then… the moment everyone needed: JK Dobbins gave a pinky promise that he’ll stay healthy for all 17 games — something he’s never done in his career. It was lighthearted, funny, and exactly the kind of confidence Broncos fans want to hear from their RB1 as camp opens. Day 1 delivered motion, explosiveness, breakout energy, and a pinky‑swear from the starting running back.
